set.body:
Purpose

Use the shared pair pattern to estimate only residual covariances that a requested support can consume, and make provenance frozen while matrices remain derived.

Acceptance

- Per atomic partition, residual cross-products and df are accumulated over the union pair graph in bounded blocks.
- Training scopes combine atomic sufficient statistics without rereading all residuals.
- A metric recipe fixes learner identity, training/evaluation policy, source revisions, regularization, seed, and hyperparameters.
- The evaluator receives an on-demand local factor/solve handle; no searchlight-by-fold factor table is retained.
- The learner is handed only the residual scope allowed by its policy, and execution receipts prove actual reads.
- Initial recipes cover identity, diagonal variance normalization, and one declared shrinkage-to-diagonal local covariance estimator.
- Metric construction exposes estimated-rank, conditioning, and regularization diagnostics without treating them as structural guarantees.
- Calibration APIs cannot ignore randomness in an estimated metric.
set.title: Epic 5: Stream residual pair statistics and derive metrics on demand
